title.rendered: The 12th MENA Investor Conference by Arqaam Capital brought together some of the region’s leading investors and CEOs in Abu Dhabi

content.rendered:
The 12th MENA Investor Conference by Arqaam Capital brought together some of the region’s leading investors and CEOs in Abu Dhabi on 19–20 May 2025, representing institutions managing over USD 1 trillion in assets. 

With its timely theme, “From Vision to Value Creation: Navigating MENA’s Market Transformation,” the conference couldn’t have come at a more critical time. It reflected the strength and sophistication of MENA markets as they evolve, offering global investors a unique window into growth opportunities across the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, and the wider GCC. 

Conversations delved into Abu Dhabi’s long-term diversification agenda, the shifting GCC macroeconomic outlook, and the transformative potential of AI and data centers as catalysts for industrial and energy market growth, with Oman’s capital market journey taking center stage as a standout story of resilience and ambition. 

A testament to the region’s drive, the conference reaffirmed that in MENA, transformation isn’t just a vision; it’s the blueprint for the future. 

Catch a glimpse of the key highlights from the conference. 

For the video, click below on View More.
